data.name: Basan
data.gender_notes: Basan is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘Basasanah’ meaning ripe fruit, this name symbolizes a mature and abundant life. It is mentioned in the Quran in Surah Al-Anfal, verse 46, where the phrase ‘Bassanatun Mutmainah’ refers to the paradise of eternal bliss. This name carries the blessings of Allah SWT and the promise of a joyful and prosperous life for the child.
data.etymology: Basan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ripe fruit.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Basan total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
